result:
If I had one impossible lever, I’d remove the distance between people—not physical distance, but the moral kind. The gap that lets you hurt someone and still sleep, or watch a stranger suffer and change the channel, or call a whole group “those people.”

I’d make another person’s reality as undeniable to you as your own hunger. Not so you’d agree with them. Not so you’d be forced to love them. Just so you could never again honestly pretend they weren’t there.

Most of the world’s cruelty runs on that pretense. Take it away, and a lot of everything else would have to be rebuilt.
